standard.description: This standard specifies the material, profile, dimensions, tolerances, and surface finish requirements for corrugated and troughed aluminium sheets used for roofing, cladding, wall panels, and partitioning in agricultural, domestic, and industrial constructions. It covers General Purpose, Industrial, Building, and High Stiffness Industrial sheets.

It covers General Purpose, Industrial, Building, and High Stiffness Industrial sheets.

qco.name: Aluminium and Aluminium Alloy Products (Quality Control) Order

certification.description: Strict Statutory Mandatory Certification. Under the 'Aluminium and Aluminium Alloy Products (Quality Control) Order' (Aluminium QCO) issued by the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India, all corrugated aluminium sheets manufactured, imported, distributed, or sold in India must conform to IS 1254 and bear the mandatory BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark). Manufacturing, importing, or selling non-certified alloy sheets in the domestic market is a statutory offense. MSMEs are granted phased transition timelines, and export-only shipments are exempt. Precious metal hallmarking is completely inapplicable to industrial alloy panels.
requirements: Every bundle or package of corrugated aluminium sheets conforming to this standard must carry the BIS Standard Mark (ISI Mark) along with the manufacturer's registered licence number (CM/L) to certify compliance.
The standard covers corrugated sheets divided into four standard varieties: a) General Purpose Sheet; b) Industrial Sheet; c) Building Sheet; d) High Stiffness Industrial Sheet.

General-purpose sheets are available in three common layout configurations: a) 8/75 General Purpose Sheet (8 corrugations); b) 10/75 General Purpose Sheet (10 corrugations); c) 16/75 General Purpose Sheet (16 corrugations).

Standard corrugation geometries must comply with: a) General Purpose: Pitch of 75 mm, depth of 19 mm, with overall widths of 650 mm and 800 mm; b) Industrial: Pitch of 125 mm, depth of 38 mm, with overall width of 795 mm (cover width of 1000/875 mm); c) Building: Pitch of 190 mm, depth of 38 mm, with overall width of 830 mm; d) High Stiffness Industrial: trapezoidal high-stiffness profile.

Sheets must be manufactured from designated corrosion-resistant manganese/magnesium-alloyed wrought aluminium categories—such as Alloy 31000, 31500, or 40800 in work-hardened H4/H18 tempers conforming to IS 737—to ensure structural load-bearing and weather resistance.
Standard sheet nominal thicknesses range from 0.45 mm up to 1.20 mm.

Unless otherwise specified by the purchaser, the diagonal distance between the corners of any finished sheet shall not differ by more than 20 mm for sheets of nominal thickness 0.45 mm and above to prevent alignment gaps during roof assembly. For sheets less than 0.45 mm thick, squareness tolerances must be mutually agreed between the manufacturer and the purchaser.

Finished corrugated sheets must be flat, straight, uniform, and free from manufacturing defects, lamination, deep scratches, scale, or visible edge-cracking. The surface finish is supplied as plain as-rolled (mill finish), embossed, or pre-coated with protective polyester, PVDF, or polyurethanes in standard colors.
